what: A wild wolf that prowls the Starfall forest edge; a low four-legged silhouette seen from the isometric camera and at eye height.

dims.basis: old wolf was 1.14u high; body length ~1.15u at a shoulder height of ~0.7u, 1u tile scale

views.why: isometric gameplay camera; body/head/tail silhouette must read at 45/30 degrees

style_notes: Low-poly diorama, leather #592F1A coat, charcoal #1A1A1A legs and muzzle, snow #E8F0FA chest, gold #D9A62E eyes, no textures. Never: smooth shading, stacked boxes, invented hues.
notes: Replaces the old 246-tri wolf with a lofted body, wedge head, ears, legs and a raised tail.
